headline: Ex-Alibaba AI chief's Pragmatik Labs closed funding at $5 billion valuation, Bloomberg reported
body: Pragmatik Labs, a Shanghai-based AI startup launched over the summer by former Alibaba AI chief Junyang Lin, closed new funding at a $5 billion valuation, Bloomberg reported, citing unnamed sources. The round raised tens of millions of dollars, and Pragmatik was valued at $2 billion when it first raised several hundred million dollars in August.
note: The reported jump from $2 billion in August to $5 billion is a sign of investor appetite for AI. Bloomberg cites unnamed sources, and Pragmatik Labs did not immediately reply to PYMNTS' request for comment.

evidence.text: Pragmatik Labs , a Shanghai-based artificial intelligence (AI) startup launched over the summer by the former AI chief of Alibaba Group Holding, Junyang Lin , closed new funding at a valuation of $5 billion, Bloomberg reported Friday (Nov. 20), citing unnamed sources.
Pragmatik Labs, which is also known as p7k, raised tens of millions of dollars in the round, according to the report.
When Pragmatik Labs raised its first financing of several hundred million dollars in August, the firm was valued at $2 billion, per the report.
Pragmatik Labs did not immediately reply to PYMNTS’ request for comment.
